entries.zh: 贵——尊贵、显贵；亦指贵重、价昂
entries.en: rich — noble, eminent; also precious, costly

entries.zh: 贵昌——显贵而昌盛
entries.en: rich and noble — flourishing in rank
entries.notes: H 栏仅录“昌”，“贵”字承上条省；M 栏 cuychiang 证全词为“贵昌”

entries.zh: 享——安享（西译“富有子嗣”，疑指享子嗣之福；第二字原稿音 hoj 未能确指）
entries.en: rich with children — to enjoy (second character in manuscript uncertain: 'hoj')
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 hoj 无对应汉字且封存件音证标注存疑，仅“享=安享”与西译“有子”可定

entries.zh: 成富——富足成业（首字存疑）
entries.en: rich — wealthy and established (first character uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏“成”与 M 栏首音 leng 不合（“成”通常不读 leng），首字或系形误（如“隆/灵”类），“富”义可定

entries.zh: 耳唇厚——耳垂丰厚（相法谓厚耳垂者富）
entries.en: rich — thick earlobes (a physiognomic sign of wealth)

entries.zh: 富丁——既富且人丁旺（财丁两旺）
entries.en: rich — wealthy and blessed with male offspring

entries.zh: 浮沉——浮起与沉没；喻人世际遇之盛衰起落
entries.en: floating and sinking — the rise and fall of fortune, vicissitudes
entries.notes: L 栏 ricoy, ymana 辨读存疑（封存件[疑:zapote/napote]）；汉侧“浮沉”清楚，取际遇起落义

entries.zh: 身分好——出身地位好（富有而势强）
entries.en: rich and strong — of good standing and status

entries.zh: 厚布——厚实细密的布
entries.en: rich — thick, densely woven cloth
entries.notes: L 栏 'mente tupida y gruesa' 之 mente 当为 tela（布）之讹，谓厚密之布

entries.zh: 财王——疑为“财翁”，即富翁
entries.en: rich man — 'king of wealth'; M 'chay-ong' more likely reads 财翁, a wealthy gentleman
entries.notes: H 录“王”，然 M chay-ong 中王/翁同音，且 L 栏与下条同为 rico hombre（富汉），取“财翁”为近

entries.zh: 富人——有钱人，富汉
entries.en: rich man

entries.zh: 财气——财大气粗之态（恃财而傲）；亦指财势、财运
entries.en: rich and haughty — arrogant airs from wealth; air of prosperity

entries.zh: 千乘——千乘之国、千乘之家；谓门第高贵、世代勋爵
entries.en: rich of great nobility and lineage — 'a thousand chariots', a great hereditary house

entries.zh: 荣华——荣华富贵，显耀富有
entries.en: rich and wealthy — glory and splendour

entries.zh: 长者——佛典大富长者（豪富之家主）；亦指年高德劭之人
entries.en: very rich — the (Buddhist) Elder, a great wealthy householder; also a venerable elder

entries.zh: 大脚数——疑指数目或家业之大（据西栏“极其富有”取义，闽语确诂待考）
entries.en: very rich — great in amount or estate (idiom uncertain)
entries.notes: “大/脚/数”三字音字可读而组合义无定说，且“脚”今读 kha 与 M 栏 ca 亦有出入

entries.zh: 豪杰——豪迈出众之人；“豪”亦含豪富强横之义
entries.en: very rich — a hero, a man of outstanding mettle

entries.zh: 豪富——豪门巨富（富有而势大）
entries.en: very rich — immense wealth, the rich and powerful

entries.zh: 吹螺富——富得张扬吹嘘（“吹螺”确义待考，据西栏取炫富声扬义）
entries.en: very rich — flaunting wealth ('blowing the conch'; idiom uncertain)
entries.notes: “吹螺”（吹海螺号角）与“极富”之关联无定说，或喻大肆炫富，存疑

entries.zh: 富贵——有钱有地位，富而且贵
entries.en: rich and honourable — wealth and rank
entries.notes: L 栏 sabio（智）与“贵”不合，或系写本之讹；汉侧“富贵”明白无疑

entries.zh: 享福——安享福分，过好日子
entries.en: rich — to enjoy blessings, live at ease
